verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents automatic escalation through a 'cost ladder' of configurations (including premium/stealth proxy tiers) that retries until a request succeeds, charging only for the successful attempt, with an 'auto' mode to let it pick the cheapest working configuration — directly matching the anti-bot retry-through-proxies story. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming the exact proxy types cycled through in the ladder, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this failover behavior in practice.
